The activation path we are preparing

  1. Review the free public listing. Accuracy and corrections never depend on payment.
  2. Establish account identity and authority. Real member control must be tied to an appropriate business or organization authority review.
  3. Choose a membership plan. Pricing follows the current Franklin membership price authority.
  4. Complete payment only when checkout is operational. A successful subscription must map to the correct Franklin member and plan.
  5. Receive the right member tools. The richer profile, growth workspace and plan capabilities must match the paid plan.
  6. Start with useful results quickly. Improve the public profile, set a growth goal and begin a practical 7/30/90-day plan.
  7. Use support and cancellation controls. Failed payments, cancellation and refunds must have defined handling before live enrollment.
